summary: DAY structural/causal pass covers all 12 companies in active batch t0-20260914T1500Z-b02. The batch maps cleanly into several 2036 dependency chains: AI compute capacity -> interconnect/optics -> power conversion -> physical manufacturing/buildout; warehouse automation -> labor/productivity constraints; geospatial sensing -> decision infrastructure; firm nuclear power -> grid/data-center power scarcity; and quantum -> specialized compute/network/security. Each company has a defensible current causal role, successor bottlenecks and explicit falsifiers. Future uncertainty is preserved as a falsifier or documented unknown, not converted into a present causal blocker. All 12 are structurally ready for Chief adjudication; underwriting readiness remains independent.

documentedUnknowns: future cluster utilization and unit economics

materialFindings.finding: The batch contains multiple beneficiaries of the same AI infrastructure buildout, but value can migrate between compute, interconnect, optics, power and manufacturing as each bottleneck is relieved. Cross-company exposure is therefore complementary but not independent; Chief should preserve correlation risk separately from company quality.

contradictions: MRVL, COHR, LITE, MPWR, CLS and APH can all benefit from AI infrastructure growth, but they compete for value capture across changing architecture boundaries; common demand does not imply common moat durability.

SYM's strong warehouse-automation causal need coexists with extreme customer concentration; concentration is an underwriting risk, not evidence that warehouse automation itself lacks structural relevance.

OKLO's power-scarcity thesis is structurally coherent while licensing and first-plant timing remain future execution uncertainties; those uncertainties are explicit falsifiers rather than current causal-evidence gaps.
unknowns: Timing of successor bottleneck migration across copper, optical and co-packaged architectures remains uncertain.

The ultimate split of AI infrastructure value among hyperscaler in-house design, merchant silicon, component vendors and contract manufacturers remains unknown and should be updated as primary evidence changes.
peerRequests: Beta red team: stress-test architecture substitution and correlated-demand failure across MRVL/COHR/LITE/MPWR/CLS/APH rather than evaluating each AI beneficiary in isolation.
Beta discovery: watch for successor bottlenecks in optical packaging, grid interconnection, rack power, quantum fabrication and warehouse general-purpose robotics.
Chief: all 12 active-batch companies are structurally ready_for_chief; keep underwriting blockers independent from this lane unless they invalidate the causal role itself.
